doc.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Fights and players unfit to work
summary: He recalls breaking up a fight on Midnight Special and sending players home for drugs or alcohol.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Did you ever — this is an odd question, but — did you ever have to break up any fist fights or the like?

Not with musicians. I did among artists on TV shows. There was a TV show called “Midnight Special” back in the old days. And again, I won’t go into who — it was two female artists and I was in the control room and I heard this commotion and literally they were out there duking it out in the hallway and I did have to get in the middle of that one. But no, not among the musicians and certainly professional artists, nothing like that. That was the only time. There were times I had to call someone aside and tell them they weren’t in shape to play on the date that day for various reasons. And I just said call it a day. Sign the card, the session card. “You’ll still get paid but you need to pack it in today.” It would usually be for what you can imagine: drugs, alcohol.
Yeah and if they did that too many times.
That’s it. Bad news travels fast.
